name: Haywood County, NC
findings: Haywood County has 174 nonprofit organizations. 83 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Haywood County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
